fragrances.name: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum
fragrances.description: A denser, darker version of Baccarat Rouge 540: saffron and bitter almond over jasmine and cedar, settling on a salty ambergris and musk base. It reads richer and more almond-sweet than the eau de parfum.
pros: Richer and more almond-forward than the EDP
Very long-lasting on skin and clothes
cons: Scent profile widely imitated by cheaper alternatives

fragrances.name: Vanilla 28
fragrances.description: A dense, sugary vanilla with a touch of jasmine on top and brown sugar, tonka and amber underneath. A light patchouli-musk edge keeps it from smelling like pure dessert.

fragrances.name: Oud for Greatness
fragrances.description: A saffron-and-nutmeg spiced oud with a lavender thread running through its woody core. The oud is smooth rather than barnyard-funky, finishing on patchouli and musk.

fragrances.name: Green Irish Tweed
fragrances.description: A crisp green fougère of violet, verbena and lemon over sandalwood, cedar and a soft ambery base. Clean, cool and polished, with a gentle herbal freshness.

fragrances.name: Herod
fragrances.description: Cinnamon-dusted tobacco leaf with a soft haze of incense, settling into creamy vanilla and cedar. It smells like sweet pipe tobacco rather than smoke.

fragrances.name: Pegasus
fragrances.description: Creamy almond and heliotrope with a touch of lavender, drying down to vanilla and sandalwood. Soft and powdery, it sits between a gourmand and a classic fougère.
pros: Easy to wear day or evening

fragrances.name: Good Girl Gone Bad
fragrances.description: A bright, heady bouquet of tuberose, jasmine and narcissus with an apricot-like osmanthus glow, resting on amber and cedar. Sunny and feminine, with more sparkle than heaviness.
cons: Tuberose can be too loud for some

fragrances.name: Elysium Pour Homme Parfum Cologne
fragrances.description: A sparkling grapefruit, lime and lemon opening laced with herbs and a hint of apple and blackcurrant, over vetiver, cedar and a soft ambergris base. Fresh and polished, an upscale everyday citrus-woody.
cons: Fresh citrus-woody style is available for far less

fragrances.name: Erba Pura
fragrances.description: A juicy, sugary blend of fruit and citrus on a musky vanilla-amber base. Bright and loud rather than subtle, it leaves a long candied-fruit trail.
cons: Can be too sweet and loud

fragrances.name: Sedley
fragrances.description: A cool, minty citrus with aromatic lavandin, geranium and a touch of pine over clean sandalwood and musk. Crisp and energetic, a fresh scent for warm days.
cons: Shorter-lived than the house's heavier scents

fragrances.name: Tuscan Leather
fragrances.description: A raw, bold leather opened by tart raspberry and saffron, with a thread of incense and jasmine before smooth suede takes over. Dense and animalic, like a new leather jacket with a fruity edge.
cons: Harsh or medicinal opening for some

fragrances.name: Fucking Fabulous
fragrances.description: A soft, suede-like leather dusted with orris and bitter almond, with lavender and clary sage adding an aromatic edge over tonka and vanilla. Plush and powdery rather than rugged.
cons: Name can be awkward to wear or gift
Powdery drydown is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Bitter Peach
fragrances.description: A ripe, boozy peach where juicy stone fruit and blood orange sink into a rum-tinged davana heart and a warm patchouli-sandalwood base. Sweet and sultry, more nightclub than orchard.

fragrances.name: Side Effect
fragrances.description: A boozy tobacco-vanilla scent with rum and cinnamon up front and a smooth, slightly airy sandalwood base. Rich and heady, suited to cold nights.

fragrances.name: Yum Pistachio Gelato 33
fragrances.description: A creamy pistachio-and-hazelnut gourmand topped with whipped cream and marshmallow, with a light fruity-floral middle that keeps it from going flat. Playful and dessert-like.

fragrances.name: Imagination
fragrances.description: A luminous citron and bergamot sharpened by ginger and a hint of cinnamon, drying down to black tea, guaiac wood and ambroxan. Clean, refined and easy to wear.
cons: Longevity only average for the price

fragrances.name: Ombre Nomade
fragrances.description: A dark, smoky oud with incense and birch, lifted by a jammy raspberry-rose note and softened by benzoin. Dense and resinous, it lingers for hours.
pros: Deep, smoky oud with a fruity lift
cons: Smoky oud is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Royal Oud
fragrances.description: A light, dry oud framed by grapefruit, cardamom and angelica, with cedar and a soft incense-benzoin base. Airy and wearable, an oud for people who dislike heavy oud.

fragrances.name: Himalaya
fragrances.description: A cool, dry citrus-woody scent: lemon, mandarin and bergamot over juniper and pepper, settling into sandalwood, vetiver and cedar. Understated and clean.

fragrances.name: Viking
fragrances.description: A peppery, minty fougère where bright citrus and pink pepper meet clove, lavender and a hint of rose, finishing on vetiver and cedar. Brisk and energetic with a spicy bite.

fragrances.name: Aventus for Her
fragrances.description: Tart lemon and green apple open onto a rose heart sharpened with pink pepper and a touch of pineapple, then settle into patchouli, a faint birch smokiness and musk. A crisp fruity rose with a woody backbone, drier and less sugary than most feminine fruity florals.
cons: Patchouli base can feel sharp to some

fragrances.name: Millésime Impérial
fragrances.description: Bergamot and black currant with a green violet-leaf edge sit over a salty, mineral marine accord softened by orris, drying down to cedar, sandalwood and musk. A breezy, sea-air citrus that stays refined rather than sporty.
cons: Very high price for a light scent

fragrances.name: Original Santal
fragrances.description: Juniper, ginger and herbs lead into a lavender and sandalwood heart, then a sweet tonka and musk base with a mossy edge. A warm, spiced sandalwood fougère with a slightly traditional barbershop feel.

fragrances.name: Absolu Aventus
fragrances.description: Bergamot, grapefruit and ginger with the familiar pineapple give way to cardamom and cinnamon, then a resinous, earthy base of labdanum, vetiver and patchouli. A darker, spicier and denser relative of Aventus.
pros: Richer and spicier than regular Aventus
cons: Heavier than regular Aventus in hot weather

fragrances.name: Greenley
fragrances.description: Crisp green apple and citrus over a leafy petitgrain heart, drying down to clean ambery woods and cedar. Bright, airy and uncomplicated, a daytime scent with a lightly sweet green-fruit tone.
pros: Fresh, clean and easy to wear
cons: Pricey for a simple fresh scent

fragrances.name: Althaïr
fragrances.description: A short citrus and elemi lift leads to orange blossom warmed with cinnamon and cardamom, over a rich base of bourbon vanilla, praline and smoky guaiac wood. A smooth, sweet vanilla-wood scent with a spiced floral heart.
pros: Warm and enveloping in cool weather

fragrances.name: Percival
fragrances.description: Bergamot, mandarin and pink pepper over a lavender, iris and cardamom heart, settling on ambroxan, white musk and a soft tonka and fir-balsam warmth. A clean, polished aromatic that favours freshness over sweetness.
cons: Less distinctive than the house's bolder scents

fragrances.name: Haltane
fragrances.description: Bergamot and pink pepper lead into lavender, clary sage and saffron with a light praline sweetness, then deepen into oud, patchouli, vetiver and leather. A dark woody-aromatic in which the oud reads smooth rather than medicinal.

fragrances.name: Layton Exclusif
fragrances.description: Bergamot, pink pepper and cardamom lead into an aromatic geranium and lavender heart, then a rich base of oud, sandalwood, patchouli and leather. A darker, woodier take on the Layton theme, dense and warm.
cons: Unsuitable for heat or close quarters

fragrances.name: Valaya
fragrances.description: Citrus and white peach over a gentle orange blossom and white-floral heart, resting on white musk and vanilla with a dry thread of akigalawood and vetiver. A soft, clean white-musk scent with a crisp, just-washed character.

fragrances.name: Delina La Rosée
fragrances.description: Juicy lychee and pear with bergamot and pink pepper open onto a fresh rose and peony heart, over soft white musk, vanilla and a little vetiver. A lighter, dewier version of Delina suited to warmer days.
pros: More wearable in warm weather than Delina

fragrances.name: Black Phantom
fragrances.description: Dark rum and sugar cane meet roasted coffee and a bitter almond facet, over creamy sandalwood and earthy vetiver. A boozy coffee gourmand with a dark, slightly bitter edge that keeps it from turning syrupy.

fragrances.name: Straight to Heaven
fragrances.description: Rum and earthy patchouli form the core, spiced with nutmeg over a dry cedar and rosewood structure. A darker, less sugary boozy scent than most rum fragrances, with a slightly dusty woody character.

fragrances.name: Rolling in Love
fragrances.description: Soft almond and ambrette over iris, tuberose and freesia, resting on tonka, vanilla and musk. A creamy, powdery floral with a milky sweetness, gentle rather than loud.
cons: Powdery feel is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Voulez-Vous Coucher Avec Moi
fragrances.description: Tuberose and ylang-ylang with a touch of rose, softened by vanilla over a light cedar base. A creamy, heady white floral with a sensual, slightly buttery character.

fragrances.name: Roses on Ice
fragrances.description: A cool rose inspired by a gin-and-cucumber cocktail: juniper, lime and watery cucumber around a fresh rose, over soft sandalwood and musk. Light and brisk rather than jammy or sweet.

fragrances.name: Moonlight in Heaven
fragrances.description: Sparkling lemon and grapefruit with pink pepper lead into creamy coconut, milky rice and mango, drying to tonka and vetiver. A tropical gourmand that stays airy thanks to the citrus.
cons: Can feel too sweet for some

fragrances.name: Intoxicated
fragrances.description: A spiced coffee scent modelled on Turkish coffee, led by green cardamom with nutmeg and cinnamon. Warm and aromatic, with the coffee reading as roasted spice rather than dessert.
cons: Coffee can feel faint to some

fragrances.name: Oud Satin Mood
fragrances.description: Rose and oud smoothed with violet, benzoin and vanilla into a plush, sweet and velvety blend, with none of the medicinal or animalic sharpness some ouds have. Dense and long-wearing with a sweet ambery trail.
cons: Too sweet and heavy for some

fragrances.name: Gentle Fluidity Gold
fragrances.description: A soft vanilla and musk blend lifted by coriander and a hint of nutmeg over ambery woods. Warm, smooth and fairly close to the skin; the sweeter, warmer counterpart to the juniper-led Silver edition.

fragrances.name: Gentle Fluidity Silver
fragrances.description: Gin-like juniper, nutmeg and coriander sit over clean musk and a dry amberwood base, with vanilla kept faint in the background. It reads cool, spicy and airy rather than sweet.
pros: Cool juniper-spice profile that feels modern
Clean musky trail that is easy to wear
cons: Amberwood base can feel sharp to some noses

fragrances.description: Sparkling aldehydes and bergamot lead into jasmine and a white-flower accord, settling on sandalwood and white musk. It smells crisp, soapy and freshly laundered, easy to wear every day.
pros: Very easy to wear in offices and daytime
Bright aldehydic lift without being old-fashioned
cons: Musky base fades closer to skin after a few hours

fragrances.name: Amyris Homme
fragrances.description: Herbal rosemary and mandarin open onto a smooth heart of amyris wood and powdery iris, drying down to tonka and soft woods. The result is a refined, lightly sweet woody scent with a gentle, polished feel.
pros: Suits office wear and dressier occasions
cons: Costly for an eau de toilette

fragrances.name: L'Homme À la Rose
fragrances.description: Sharp grapefruit and sage frame Damask and centifolia roses over a clean amberwood base. It is a bright, dewy rose rather than a jammy one, presented with a masculine, citrus-led angle.
pros: Fresh, modern way to wear rose
Grapefruit keeps it crisp and daytime-friendly
cons: Not much depth for the price

fragrances.name: Vanilla Sex
fragrances.description: A focused vanilla fragrance that pairs deeper and brighter vanilla facets with sandalwood, orris and a touch of jasmine. It smells creamy, rich and enveloping.
pros: Rich, creamy vanilla with real depth
Strong longevity on skin and clothes
Cosy and sensual in cold weather
cons: Very expensive for a single-note focus

fragrances.name: Noir de Noir
fragrances.description: Saffron and deep rose sit on a base of black truffle, patchouli, oud and vanilla with a mossy edge. It is a dark, earthy and velvety rose, best suited to cold evenings.

fragrances.name: Tobacco Oud
fragrances.description: A whiskey-like opening warmed by cinnamon and coriander leads into dry tobacco leaf, oud, sandalwood and patchouli. It is dark, boozy and spicy, with more spice and wood than sweetness.
cons: Heavy and dense in warm weather
A little goes a long way

fragrances.name: Ébène Fumé
fragrances.description: Smoky palo santo and black pepper over resinous labdanum, dark ebony wood and a leathery undertone. It smells of incense-like smoke and polished wood, dry and meditative rather than sweet.
pros: Refined, dry smoke with no heaviness from sugar
cons: Smoke can feel austere to some

fragrances.name: Cherry Smoke
fragrances.description: Dark cherry and saffron open onto leathery osmanthus, then settle into smoked woods, frankincense and balsam. It is a darker, drier and smokier take on cherry than Lost Cherry.
pros: Stands apart from sweeter cherry scents
cons: Smoky-fruity mix is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Costa Azzurra
fragrances.description: Lemon, bergamot and cypress with a touch of lavender sit over driftwood, oak and salty amber, with a resinous cistus edge. It smells like sun-bleached wood and Mediterranean shrubs by the sea, dry and salty rather than sweet.
pros: Holds up well in hot weather
Less sweet than typical summer scents
cons: High price for a fresh scent

fragrances.name: Pacific Chill
fragrances.description: Lemon, blackcurrant, mint and basil lead a juicy blend with carrot, fig, apricot and dates over soft ambrette. It smells like a freshly pressed juice: cool, tangy and lightly sweet.
cons: Very high price for a fresh scent
Fruity-vegetal opening is not for everyone

fragrances.name: Météore
fragrances.description: A sparkling citrus opening of bergamot and mandarin is roughened by pepper and nutmeg, then settles on dry vetiver. It is fresh, crisp and slightly spicy, an easy daytime scent.
pros: Crisp, clean citrus with a spicy edge
Easy to wear without much thought
cons: Hard to justify the price over designer citrus scents

fragrances.name: L'Immensité
fragrances.description: Grapefruit, ginger and bergamot give a sharp, zesty opening that dries down to an airy ambroxan and labdanum base. It reads fresh and clean, with a warm, slightly salty-feeling amber trail.
pros: Strong performance for a fresh scent
Works for office, travel and summer days
cons: Ambroxan base may feel familiar to people who know popular fresh designers

fragrances.name: Attrape-Rêves
fragrances.description: Juicy lychee and peony meet a dusting of cocoa over earthy patchouli. It smells sweet and plush, a fruity floral with a dark cocoa twist.
pros: Cosy and sensual in cooler months
cons: Can turn too sweet for some

fragrances.name: Spell On You
fragrances.description: A powdery floral centered on iris and rose, softened by acacia and a touch of jasmine. It is soft and elegant, with a smooth, cosmetic-like powderiness.
cons: Powderiness can feel old-fashioned to some

fragrances.name: California Dream
fragrances.description: Juicy mandarin and pink pepper over musky ambrette and a warm benzoin base. It starts bright and then turns soft, warm and resinous.
pros: Bright citrus with a warm, cosy drydown
Easy to wear in most seasons
cons: Soft projection after the first hour
Luxury price for a simple structure

fragrances.name: Rehab
fragrances.description: Bergamot and black pepper lead into a calm lavender heart over cedar, sandalwood, patchouli and soft musk. It is clean yet cosy, a smooth aromatic-woody scent that works in most settings.
cons: Pricey for what can read as a simple blend
Musky drydown may feel generic to some

fragrances.name: Atomic Rose
fragrances.description: A bright rose built from Turkish and Bulgarian roses, lifted by bergamot and airy Hedione, then softened by jasmine and a smooth vanilla base. It smells radiant and slightly sweet, a modern rose with noticeable projection.
cons: Vanilla sweetness can feel heavy in hot weather

fragrances.name: Musk Therapy
fragrances.description: A soft musk blend brightened by bergamot, mandarin and tart blackcurrant, with magnolia and sandalwood underneath. It smells clean, lightly fruity and skin-like.
pros: Fruity lift keeps it from feeling flat
cons: Musk may be hard for some noses to detect

fragrances.name: Eden Juicy Apple 01
fragrances.description: A tart-sweet red apple and blackcurrant opening with a splash of grapefruit, softening into berries, jasmine and rose over a sugary vanilla and musk base. Bright and playful rather than deep.
cons: Fruit fades after a few hours

fragrances.name: Alexandria II
fragrances.description: A polished oud built on cedar and sandalwood, opened by apple, cinnamon, lavender and rosewood with a Bulgarian rose heart. Smooth and rounded rather than animalic, drying down to creamy amber and vanilla.

fragrances.name: Torino21
fragrances.description: A crisp mint and citrus scent with lemon and bergamot over lavender, clean and energetic in a sporty, herbal way. Xerjoff does not publish an official note list for it, so the notes shown are the commonly reported ones.
cons: Can smell like a simple herbal cologne

fragrances.name: Burlington 1819
fragrances.description: A bold citrus opening of grapefruit, lime, mandarin and bitter orange with a touch of mint, warmed by ginger, cinnamon and saffron before a boozy rum and tobacco base with patchouli, oakmoss and woods. Bright on top with a spicy, resinous backbone.

fragrances.name: Reflection Man
fragrances.description: Neroli, jasmine and orris over sandalwood and vetiver, opened by rosemary, pink pepper and petitgrain. Clean, polished and soft-spoken, it smells freshly groomed rather than loud.
cons: Florals may feel too soft for some

fragrances.name: Interlude Woman
fragrances.description: A floral chypre where bergamot, grapefruit and ginger lead into incense, rose, orange blossom and helichrysum, settling on opoponax, oakmoss, leather and oud. Resinous and a little smoky, with a dense, old-world texture.
cons: Dense and heavy for warm days
Harder to find than Interlude Man

fragrances.name: Jubilation XXV
fragrances.description: Frankincense, labdanum and myrrh meet blackberry, davana and honey, with rose and orchid in the heart and oud, ambergris and moss beneath. Dark, fruity-smoky and plush, it wears like a formal amber.

fragrances.name: Guidance
fragrances.description: Juicy pear and toasted hazelnut over a veil of frankincense, moving into saffron, rose, jasmine and osmanthus before a creamy sandalwood, ambergris and vanilla base. Sweet and plush, lifted by incense.

fragrances.name: Epic Woman
fragrances.description: Cumin, pink pepper and cinnamon open onto Damask rose, geranium and tea, then settle into incense, oud, sandalwood and a powdery orris and vanilla drydown. Warm, spiced and enveloping, with a smoky glow.

fragrances.name: Wūlóng Chá
fragrances.description: A bright blend of bergamot, orange, mandarin and litsea cubeba that settles into a lightly spiced oolong tea heart and a soft fig and musk base. Airy, sparkling and clean.
pros: Solid performance for a fresh scent
cons: Can turn sharp on some skin

fragrances.name: Hundred Silent Ways
fragrances.description: Creamy tuberose, gardenia and jasmine with a soft peach and mandarin opening, resting on vanilla, sandalwood and a thread of vetiver. Lush and romantic, with the white florals rounded off by a powdery sweetness.

fragrances.name: Intense Café
fragrances.description: Roasted coffee wrapped around a velvety rose, sweetened by vanilla and amber with a soft white musk finish. Gourmand yet floral, with dense, long-clinging projection.

fragrances.name: Arabians Tonka
fragrances.description: Saffron and bergamot lead into rose and oud, sweetened heavily by tonka and brown sugar over amber, leather and oakmoss. Dense, sugary and smoky-woody, with strong projection.
pros: Good value for a niche oud
cons: Very loud and easy to overapply

fragrances.name: Cedrat Boise
fragrances.description: Sicilian lemon and blackcurrant with a cool spice lift over water jasmine and patchouli leaf, drying down to cedar, sandalwood, leather, oakmoss and a touch of vanilla. Fresh, fruity-woody and polished.

fragrances.name: Red Tobacco
fragrances.description: Cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and incense wrap around green apple, white peach and oud, then settle into a thick tobacco, amber and vanilla base. Spicy, fruity and smoky at once, with a room-filling presence.
cons: Oud and incense can feel harsh up close

fragrances.name: Instant Crush
fragrances.description: Citrus, saffron and ginger open onto Moroccan rose, jasmine and a warm amber heart, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood, oakmoss and white musk. Sweet, radiant and ambery, with a noticeable trail.
cons: Can be too sweet for some
Strong sillage needs a light hand

fragrances.name: Bal d'Afrique
fragrances.description: Bergamot, lemon and neroli brightened by African marigold and buchu, then a soft floral heart of violet, jasmine and cyclamen over vetiver, cedar, black amber and musk. Sunny and warm-hearted, balancing citrus freshness with a gentle woody glow.
cons: Wears close after a few hours

fragrances.name: Bibliothèque
fragrances.description: Soft peach and plum melt into a dry floral heart of peony and violet, then drift onto supple leather, dusty patchouli and vanilla. Quiet and nostalgic, with a leathery warmth that suits its library-inspired name.
pros: Distinctive fruity leather and violet blend
cons: Fruit can seem synthetic to some

fragrances.name: Super Cedar
fragrances.description: A minimalist cedar scent with a touch of rose up top and a clean musk and vetiver base, often likened to pencil shavings. Dry, airy and understated, it sits close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Eleventh Hour
fragrances.description: Tingling Sichuan pepper and bergamot give way to a boozy rum, earthy carrot seed and wild fig heart, resting on tonka and cashmere wood. Unusual and slightly strange, it shifts between spicy, fruity and woody facets.
pros: Unisex and easy in cool seasons

fragrances.name: Thé Noir 29
fragrances.description: A dry black tea scent wrapped in fig, bay leaf and cedar, with a hay-and-tobacco warmth underneath. It reads calm, slightly dusty and woody rather than sweet.
pros: Easy to wear in most settings
cons: Some find it flat after the opening

fragrances.name: Bergamote 22
fragrances.description: A bright bergamot and grapefruit opening that settles onto orange blossom, vetiver and a soft amber-musk base. Crisp and uncomplicated, it smells more like fresh citrus peel than sugary fruit.
pros: Easy in heat and at the office

fragrances.name: Lys 41
fragrances.description: A dense white bouquet of lily, tuberose and jasmine, sweetened by vanilla and softened with musk. Creamy and heady, it leans lush and projecting rather than airy.
pros: Lush white floral with good presence
cons: Can feel heavy in close quarters
Too sweet and heady for some

fragrances.name: Oud 27
fragrances.description: A dark, animalic oud dusted with saffron and rose over patchouli, cedar, vetiver and incense. Dry, smoky and intentionally rough-edged, it is far from a sweet, easy oud.
cons: Hard to wear at the office

fragrances.name: Orphéon Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: Gin-like juniper sits over a light jasmine heart and a powdery cedar-and-tonka base. The result is a dry, polished woody scent with only a faint sweetness.
cons: Quiet projection after a few hours

fragrances.name: Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum
fragrances.description: A soft, powdery musk built around iris, ambrette and a touch of rose, lifted at the start by pink pepper, bergamot and angelica. Intimate and skin-like, it reads as a clean personal aura more than a loud perfume.

fragrances.name: Eau Duelle Eau de Toilette
fragrances.description: Vanilla made dry and airy with black tea, pink pepper, cardamom and juniper, over a resinous frankincense and elemi base. It is a spiced, lightly smoky vanilla rather than a dessert-like one.

fragrances.name: Carnal Flower
fragrances.description: A large, naturalistic tuberose given a green, slightly cool edge by eucalyptus and melon, with jasmine, ylang-ylang and a creamy coconut-musk base. Rich and radiant, it is built to be noticed.

fragrances.name: Musc Ravageur
fragrances.description: A warm, spicy musk where cinnamon and clove sit over a thick base of vanilla, amber, tonka and soft woods, opened by a brief flash of lavender and citrus. Sensual and enveloping, with strong staying power.

fragrances.name: Lipstick Rose
fragrances.description: A powdery rose and violet composition sweetened with vanilla and iris, built to evoke vintage lipstick and face powder. Playful and retro, with a waxy cosmetic character that divides opinion.

fragrances.name: Vetiver Extraordinaire
fragrances.description: A vetiver built on an unusually large dose of the material, kept dry, woody and slightly smoky, sharpened by bergamot and pink pepper and rounded by cedar and myrrh. Clean-cut and refined rather than rough or earthy-damp.

fragrances.name: Geranium pour Monsieur
fragrances.description: A cool, minty geranium with clove and cinnamon adding bite, settling onto sandalwood, incense and clean white musk. Fresh and crisp yet grown-up, it sits between a barbershop aromatic and a modern musk.

fragrances.name: Ambre Sultan
fragrances.description: A resinous, herbal amber where oregano, bay leaf, myrtle and coriander meet thick labdanum, benzoin and vanilla. Dry and aromatic rather than candied, it grows warmer and softer as it wears.

fragrances.name: La Fille de Berlin
fragrances.description: A bold red rose sharpened with pepper and geranium, with a hint of violet giving it a powdery, slightly metallic sheen. It treats rose as something assertive rather than delicate.

fragrances.name: Santal Majuscule
fragrances.description: Creamy sandalwood warmed by cocoa and tonka bean, with a rose facet running through the middle. Smooth, gently sweet and woody, it wears as a comfortable, polished sandalwood.

fragrances.name: The Tragedy of Lord George
fragrances.description: A boozy tonka scent where brandy is layered over vetiver and amber, with a smooth, slightly barbershop-like finish. Warm and gentlemanly, it suits cooler evenings.

fragrances.name: Endymion
fragrances.description: Lavender, sage and citrus over a soft coffee-and-nutmeg heart, drying down to vetiver, leather and musk. Refined and easy to wear, it balances a fresh aromatic opening with a gently warm finish.

fragrances.name: Replica Bubble Bath
fragrances.description: A foamy, clean soap accord of lavender, coconut milk and white musk meant to recall a warm bath. Soft and cosy, it stays mostly close to the skin.

fragrances.name: Replica Coffee Break
fragrances.description: Milky coffee paired with lavender, giving a soft latte-like gourmand that is creamy rather than roasted and bitter. Relaxed and comforting, with modest projection.

fragrances.name: Replica Whispers in the Library
fragrances.description: Soft vanilla and dry cedar under a light peppery opening, often likened to the papery, wooden warmth of a quiet reading room. It stays close to the skin and comes across as calm and cosy rather than sugary.
pros: Easy to wear in close quarters
cons: Pricey for an eau de toilette
Can read as a plain vanilla

fragrances.name: Lady Vengeance
fragrances.description: A deep, slightly jammy rose set over earthy patchouli and a smooth vanilla base, with a vintage rose-chypre mood softened by modern sweetness. Dark and a little brooding, it suits cooler evenings best.

fragrances.name: Kirkè
fragrances.description: A dense, juicy mix of passion fruit, peach, raspberry and blackcurrant resting on soft musk, sandalwood and powdery heliotrope. Sweet and bright rather than floral; as an extrait de parfum it wears dense and long.
cons: High price for a fruity scent
